model.name: Model for apixaban absorption and intestinal secretion

notes.body:
Model for apixaban absorption and intestinal secretion
The tablet dissolves with a rate which saturates with the dose (PODOSE_50), the solution reaches the lumen of the small intestine with Ka_sol_api. The dissolved apixaban is absorbed with first order kinetics (APIABS_k) in competition with the small intestinal transit into the colon (SITRANS_k), which also carries the undissolved tablet, the apixaban secreted from the plasma into the small intestine (P-gp/BCRP, APISEC_k, f_pgp) and the metabolites secreted with the bile. Nothing is absorbed from the colon, its content is excreted with the fecal transit (LUMEX_k).
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort.

body.p: First order absorption of the dissolved apixaban in the lumen of the small intestine. The absorption competes with the small intestinal transit into the colon (SITRANS_k), the fraction absorbed is F_api_abs = APIABS_k/(APIABS_k + SITRANS_k).
The value of GU__APIABS_k is the result of the fit PK_20261017_103232__85dfa, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: rate of the small intestinal transit

body.p: Transit of the content of the small intestine into the colon, a mean transit time of about 3.5 hr (1-8 hr). The transit carries the unabsorbed and the secreted apixaban, the undissolved tablet and the metabolites; nothing is absorbed from the colon.
The value of GU__SITRANS_k is the result of the fit PK_20261017_103232__85dfa, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.
Transit of the content of the colon into the feces, a mean transit time of about 30 hr (24-36 hr).

parameter.name: intestinal secretion clearance of unbound apixaban

body.p: Efflux of apixaban from the enterocytes into the lumen (P-gp, BCRP), a clearance of the unbound concentration in the plasma of the gut. Apixaban is eliminated unchanged into the gut (Frost2021, Wang2014: activated charcoal lowers the AUC). The clearance does not depend on the body weight.
The value of GU__APISEC_k is the result of the fit PK_20261017_103232__85dfa, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

The value of GU__Ka_dis_api is the result of the fit PK_20261017_103232__85dfa, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

The dissolution of the tablet saturates with the undissolved dose (solubility): the rate is Ka_dis_api * PODOSE_api/(1 + PODOSE_api/PODOSE_50), linear for doses well below PODOSE_50.
The value of GU__PODOSE_50 is the result of the fit PK_20261017_103232__85dfa, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.
